title: Wire Drag Compatible Nodes And Ring
description: When a wire/link is active: highlight all compatible target nodes with secondary color; on hover show indirect handle ring with only compatible handles; emit board events.
summary: Active link wire (LinkDragSnap / LinkTargetNode) highlights every compatible target node with indirect secondary fill/stroke. Hovering a compatible target with multiple free handles shows a ghost ring of only link-compatible handles; sole-handle targets stay implicit. Removed source-node ring during drag. New WASM events linkCompatibleNodes and linkTargetRing (cleared on wire end); wired through BoardRenderer and BoardCanvas props onLinkCompatibleNodes / onLinkTargetRing.
